title: The Joining the Warm-Up Clap
youtube_title: The Joining the Warm-Up Clap | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Speaking up once, softly, can open a door.
summary: At a music corner with a drum and a recorder, Kei feels shy about a warm-up clap that felt loud. Instead of pretending not to care, Kei tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie Luz stays kind and does not push for a show.
